name: mcp-search
description: DuckDuckGo search MCP (nickclyde/duckduckgo-mcp-server) with a launcher wrapper that disables FastMCP's DNS-rebinding protection. The compose inlines the launcher as a heredoc; the files in this directory are dev/inspection scripts. This package.json exists only to satisfy the root npm workspaces glob (packages/*).

scripts.build: echo 'Python MCP — no npm build; container built from python:3.12-slim at compose up'
scripts.start: echo 'Run via docker compose: docker compose up mcp-search'
